entities.summary: John David Jamerson is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Miami Heat in the first round of the 1990 NBA draft. Jamerson played for the Houston Rockets, Utah Jazz and New Jersey Nets in three National Basketball Association (NBA) seasons as well as four Continental Basketball Association (CBA) teams.
